operators.name: mul_tensor

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as reference step input x; in this task [512, 3, 512, 512]

semantics: Computes element-wise multiplication: out[i] = x[i] * y[i].
No broadcasting is performed; both tensors must have the same shape and be contiguous.
The operation preserves the input dtype and device, and returns a newly allocated tensor.
Element-wise multiplication of two float32 tensors with identical shape [512, 3, 512, 512].
Produces a new tensor with the same shape, dtype, and device.
The result is assigned to variable x.
Returns the tensor x computed in the previous step.
No further computation or transformation is applied.
